card.name: The word difficile after Clostridium
card.fires_on: The word "difficile" right after "Clostridium" or "C." in text about C. difficile-associated diarrhea (CDAD) warnings.

modes.label: After C.

modes.description: "difficile" follows the full genus name Clostridium.
